calls.statement:
SELECT 'sales_lines' AS what, count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS dist_id, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) AS dist_rl, min(sale_date) AS mn, max(sale_date) AS mx, count(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) AS loads FROM fact_sales_line
UNION ALL
SELECT 'web_orders', count(*), count(DISTINCT web_order_id), NULL, min(CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE)), max(CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE)), NULL FROM fact_web_order
UNION ALL
SELECT 'returns', count(*), count(DISTINCT return_line_id), count(DISTINCT sales_line_id), min(return_date), max(return_date), NULL FROM fact_return_line

WITH dup AS (
  SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM fact_sales_line GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1
)
SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.sale_date, f.store_key, f.product_key, f.channel_code, f.quantity, f.net_amount, f.etl_loaded_at
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dup USING (receipt_id, line_no)
ORDER BY f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.sales_line_id
LIMIT 24

WITH dup AS (
  SELECT receipt_id, line_no, count(*) c, count(DISTINCT (product_key, quantity, net_amount, sale_ts_utc, store_key)) variants, min(sale_date) d
  FROM fact_sales_line GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1
)
SELECT c, variants, count(*) n, min(d), max(d), sum(CASE WHEN receipt_id IN (SELECT web_order_id FROM fact_web_order) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) web_n
FROM dup GROUP BY 1,2

SELECT s.store_id, (f.receipt_id IN (SELECT web_order_id FROM fact_web_order)) AS orig_is_web_order, count(*) n, sum(r.refund_net) refund_net,
       min(r.return_date) mn, max(r.return_date) mx
FROM fact_return_line r
JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
WHERE r.return_date >= DATE '2025-11-03'
GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING orig_is_web_order OR s.store_id >= 900

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT w.dispatch_date AS business_date, s.store_id, p.sku, f.net_amount AS net_sales, 0 AS ret
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, p.sku, -r.refund_net, 1
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT cp.sku, cp.product_name, cp.category, cp.subcategory,
       ROUND(SUM(n.net_sales), 2) AS web_net_sales,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN n.ret = 0 THEN n.net_sales END), 2) AS before_returns
FROM net_lines n
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = n.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE n.business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-03' AND DATE '2026-10-04'
GROUP BY 1,2,3,4
ORDER BY web_net_sales DESC
LIMIT 14

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, status,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
),
lines AS (
    SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.net_amount, s.store_id, p.category, w.status, w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date, f.channel_code
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE (s.store_id = 900 OR w.web_order_id IS NOT NULL OR f.channel_code='WB')
)
SELECT store_id, category = 'ZZ Test' AS is_test, status, 
       (dispatch_date >= DATE '2025-11-03') AS disp_in_window, (sale_date >= DATE '2025-11-03') AS sale_in_window,
       count(*) n, round(sum(net_amount),2) net
FROM lines GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3,4,5
